integrity.computational_checks: Independent exact-rational matrix checks for selected finite base graphs; not a substitute for the proof.
integrity.literature_scope: Inspected full HTML of the most plausible general symmetry paper and modern matching-clique discussion; one overlapping-clique source accessible only at abstract level.
integrity.proof_scope: Analytic graph-spectrum and symmetry reduction, with full explicit parameter boundaries.

scientific_limitations: Restricted to finite connected simple vertex-and-edge-transitive base graphs and real symmetric stochastic transitions.
No uniqueness is asserted among all unrestricted non-invariant optimizers.
Loopless bipartite cases are periodic; SLEM is 1, not genuine mixing.
Only asymptotic nontrivial spectral modulus is optimized; finite-time total-variation and nonreversible problems are excluded.
Full historical-source equivalence cannot be ruled out by a finite literature search.
title: Sharp loopless fastest mixing on \(H\square K_2\) for transitive regular graphs
